gateSemantics.metrics: All five audit numericValue fields are copied exactly from the raw LHR; scores are LHR category fractions converted to the captured integer0–100 scale.

retainedSevereResult.qualification: Single severe saved NL reservations mobile result retained without rerun or replacement. This report makes no application-cause attribution.

sourceEvidence.qualification: Descriptor and recorded source checks identify the compiled capture; they do not assert current workspace input identity after timing cleared. Media hashes are local-file manifest hashes, not response hashes.

capturedHostEvidence.method: Process CPU snapshots before first pending wave and after each5runs; captured source monitor checked at these checkpoints, not a new current-workspace check.
capturedHostEvidence.limitations: Shared host. Sampled CPU/process names do not certify continuous idle or exclude unsampled GPU,I/O,scheduler or unrelated workload. The after30 checkpoint recorded ffmpeg with CPUdelta0; do not infer no process existed or continuous contention absence.

proofNaming.hashes: Each row directly hashes LHR,trace and first-visit JSON. The exact serverHTML SHA is recorded inside its hashed first-visit JSON and was verified during assembly. Devtools filenames resolve by the shared suffix; their contents remain local raw evidence.

qualifications.native-trace: Native trace candidate recorded; numeric LCP remains simulated Lighthouse, not field data.
qualifications.UKM fallback numeric metric retained; na: No eligible native trace LCP established. Numeric UKM fallback/score preserved verbatim; separate observer entries cannot validate or replace the missing trace candidate.
qualifications.observer: nativePaint is a separate after-gathers diagnostic, not the Lighthouse trace timeline. Four home rows retain its visibility,viewport,entry-count and film context; remaining details are in the full matrix. Eligible nonhome-row observer/visibility detail is omitted from this compact table and remains in the hashed full matrix.
qualifications.inp: Not measured by Lighthouse; this file provides no INP acceptance. Separate bounded interaction samples are separate evidence.
qualifications.budgets: This report does not establish JS/CSS/HTML/API/image budgets or all user requirements.

limitations: Interim original-v4 control only; user-edited v2 is pending. No CapCut v1/v2 integration, user-video acceptance, final-video performance or full-site final acceptance is implied.
One sequential simulated local-lab sample per route/device; no field CWV, confidence intervals, search-ranking or guaranteed performance claim.
All48 scores and raw numeric values are retained, including NL reservations mobile P39/TBT11663ms. No rerun selected a better number.
Four home LCP results remain native-unknown/UKM-derived even though their numeric LHR values and scores are retained. No missing native result counts as an LCP pass.
Native observer diagnostics, observed trace data and Lantern simulated metrics are different timelines and must not be conflated.
Lighthouse storage reset was preserved; first-visit state is separately verified. Server image caches were not purged, and preflight may have warmed variants.
Gallery uses an explicit empty-public-upload fixture200, not actual uploaded gallery content.
Shared-host samples are bounded observations only; no causal explanation for the severe route or startup reset is established here.
Captured source/build identity applies only to the measured artifact. Root edits may resume after capture; current workspace and future video changes are not represented.
Raw files remain at the local proof root. Catalog storage URL arrays and raw HTML bodies are not copied into this compact report.
